NWS Detroit/Pontiac · 544 PM EST Fri Nov 20 2026
 

- Near record high temperatures in the mid to upper 60s this 
weekend.  

- Rain showers likely late Sunday.

- Turning much colder Monday with below normal temperatures 
continuing through next week.

&&

.AVIATION...

Deep layer dry air will remain in tact across Se Mi tonight and 
Saturday as strong high pressure holds across the eastern seaboard 
and upper Ohio Valley. The position of the sfc high will sustain a 
light south wind through the period. Some degree of southeasterly 
component will support a little higher boundary layer moisture off 
Lake Erie into Metro Detroit, lending to higher chances for fog 
development. Current probabilistic guidance is not yet supportive of 
dense fog. This will however be monitored through the night.
